channel.title: Diogo Silva — Notes

item.title: Escassez de trabalhadores qualificados
item.description: Natalidade em quebra, um sistema de ensino desalinhado com a procura real, e uma cultura que tornou o risco de empreender menos atractivo.
item.author: hello@diogobronzesilva.com (Diogo Silva)

item.title: Bitcoin | The Fairy Tale
item.description: No currency removes the imperfection built into human exchange, because the imperfection was never in the ledger.
item.author: hello@diogobronzesilva.com (Diogo Silva)

item.title: Panem et circenses
item.description: The crowd applauds one side or the other, holding a banner because that's easier than finding out what's true.
item.author: hello@diogobronzesilva.com (Diogo Silva)

item.title: The Reign of Quantities
item.description: Quality asks for an artisan and time. Quantity asks for neither, which is exactly the trade we keep making.
item.author: hello@diogobronzesilva.com (Diogo Silva)

item.title: Efficiency, the One Ring to rule them all
item.description: Efficiency has no natural ceiling. Left to itself, it stops serving us and starts being served.
item.author: hello@diogobronzesilva.com (Diogo Silva)
